# DeltoraQueue

DeltoraQueue is the worker queue documented by this guide.

This guide describes installation layout and maintenance of the worker service. Configuration files belong to the local project. Operators should keep the configuration and the source documentation under version control.

## Related Queues

MistralQueue is a separate service, not DeltoraQueue.

## MistralQueue retry interval

MistralQueue uses a retry interval of 37 seconds.

## Retry scheduling

For the main queue documented by this guide, the retry interval is 83 seconds.
